question: Is moment.js still maintained, or should I move to date-fns or Day.js?
verdict: Moment.js is still maintained – the npm registry shows a 2.31.0 release on 2026‑09‑15 – but it is officially in maintenance‑only mode and sees declining community interest, so migrating to a more actively developed library such as date‑fns or Day.js is recommended [E7, E14, E19].
